title: Image serverless worker output (image-serverless/v1)
description: Result of one job: the generated image (exactly one of image or image_url) and the measured telemetry.

image.description: Base64-encoded image (PNG/JPEG/WebP) for small results (see OUTPUT_INLINE_MAX_MB / OUTPUT_INLINE_BUDGET_MB).

image_url.description: Presigned HTTP(S) URL for large results uploaded to S3-compatible storage (see S3_* and OUTPUT_URL_TTL_SECONDS).

telemetry.description: Execution-fact telemetry. Every required field is measured by the worker from the executed graph, the produced image bytes and torch.cuda; expected values from parameter/acceleration are never substituted.

gpu_cc.description: Compute capability of the GPU that ran the job (torch.cuda), e.g. 8.6 for RTX A6000, 8.9 for L40S.

gpu_class.description: GPU class reported by torch.cuda, for example RTX A6000 or L40S.

seconds.description: Measured wall-clock seconds from graph submit to history completion.

width.description: Fact width of the produced image in pixels, read from its header.

height.description: Fact height of the produced image in pixels, read from its header.

model_name.description: Diffusion model file name read from the executed graph loader node (unet_name/ckpt_name).

seed.description: Seed read from the executed sampler graph (KSampler.seed, RandomNoise.noise_seed, ...).

steps.description: Sampler steps read from the executed graph.

cfg.description: CFG scale read from the executed sampler/guider node.

sampler.description: Sampler name read from the executed graph (KSampler.sampler_name, KSamplerSelect.sampler_name).

scheduler.description: Scheduler name read from the executed graph (KSampler.scheduler, BasicScheduler.scheduler).

text_detected.description: OCR fact for keyframe validation. Omitted by this worker: there is no OCR engine in the image, so the field is not reported (never a silent false). The application records the OCR fact itself.
